title: Finance-Charge Convention for Lender and Lessor Payoffs, Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
**Convention.** When the payoff stated by a lender or lessor on a Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage total loss is measured back to the loss date, the finance charge removed from the stated payoff is set as follows. Where the loss payee named on the coverage is a leasing company (its name contains the word Leasing) and more than 10 days have passed from the loss date to the acceptance date of the surrender settlement, the lease rent charge is removed by whole months instead of by days: the finance charge is the stated payoff times the assumed contract rate divided by twelve, times the whole months from the loss date to the acceptance date, rounded to the cent. Where no more than 10 days have passed, whatever the loss payee, no finance charge is removed and the stated payoff is used as stated. Otherwise the finance charge is removed by days: the stated payoff times the assumed contract rate times the days from the loss date to the acceptance date, divided by 365, rounded to the cent.

Days are counted from the loss date to the acceptance date, the loss date not counted; whole months are complete calendar months between the two dates. The loss payee name is read from the physical damage coverage record.

## Basis questions and answers (hypothetical figures, assumed contract rate 9.4 percent)

**A lender is loss payee; the loss is on March 1 and the settlement is accepted on March 11.** That is 10 days, so no finance charge is removed.

**The same lender; accepted on March 12.** 11 days: removed by days. On a stated payoff of 20000.00 the charge is 20000.00 times 9.4 percent times 11, divided by 365, which gives 56.66.

**A loss payee named Lakeshore Auto Leasing; loss on January 10, accepted on March 15.** More than 10 days, and the name contains Leasing: removed by whole months. Two whole months have passed; on a stated payoff of 30000.00 the charge is 30000.00 times 9.4 percent divided by twelve, times 2, which gives 470.00.

**The same leasing company; loss on March 1, accepted on March 12.** More than 10 days, removed by whole months; no whole month has passed, so the charge is 0.00.

## Tiers

| Days from loss to acceptance | Loss payee name contains Leasing | Finance charge removed |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | Either | None |
| More than 10 | Yes | By whole months, divided by twelve |
| More than 10 | No | By days, divided by 365 |
